dependencyPolicy.backendPolicy: videoio backend availability must be recorded per target; headless does not imply every camera or GUI backend is available

abiPolicy.manifestPolicy: profile-specific generated ABI manifest; do not reuse the full-profile manifest by assertion
abiPolicy.highguiBehavior: existing managed HighGui entrypoints remain visible and take the deterministic NOT_LINKED or unsupported path

negativeSmoke: ImShow/NamedWindow/DestroyWindow/trackbar calls fail deterministically without hanging
codec read/write succeeds under the existing preflight and size-limit policy
VideoIO backend result is explicit and completes within the configured timeout
DNN representative call succeeds when the selected profile contains dnn
a second native call remains usable after a failed GUI call
no worker, socket, or native handle remains after a timed-out backend attempt
promotionGates: Full and Mini producers use the same OpenCV source/version and profile-specific provenance
Every shipped ELF has a matching producer hash and no forbidden GUI SONAME
Ubuntu 22.04, Ubuntu 24.04, and Debian 12 consumer evidence passes for both profiles
Independent consumer restores only the headless candidate and records package/loader/OS/libc facts
Native smoke covers codec, DNN, and the documented VideoIO backend result without a display server
Support contract, SBOM, closeout, and rollback fixtures classify the package as candidate-only until every row is complete

rollback.onFailure: delete candidate artifacts and evidence, remove candidate-only rows, and retain existing distro-specific identities
